territorial_scope.description: Applies to conduct in Japan; certain patent offences also apply to conduct abroad (Art. 92(3)); designations and orders are addressed to specified operators.

evidence.quote: 第一項第六号及び第八号の罪は、日本国外においてこれらの号の罪を犯した者にも適用する。

summary.short: Japanese statute on ensuring national security through integrated economic measures. Sets a basic policy and creates regimes for supply security of designated critical goods, notification and review of equipment in designated social infrastructure, support for critical technology R&D, and non-disclosure of sensitive patent applications, in stages by Cabinet Order.
summary.long: The Act (Act No. 43 of 2022) sets a framework for national security through economic measures. It requires a basic policy (Art. 2) and a public-private council (Art. 3-2). Cabinet Order may designate specified critical goods (Art. 7); certified supply-security plans may receive financing and subsidies (Arts. 9, 13-34). Ministers may designate specified social infrastructure operators, such as electricity, gas, water, rail, ports, telecommunications and finance (Art. 50). Such operators must notify before introducing or outsourcing maintenance of specified critical equipment; a 30-day waiting period applies and ministers may recommend changes or order a halt (Art. 52). The Act also supports R&D in specified critical technologies (Arts. 60-63), requires secrecy review of certain patent applications and restricts their disclosure and foreign filing (Arts. 66-78), and supports specified overseas businesses (Arts. 85-2 to 85-10). Violations carry up to two years' imprisonment and/or fines up to 1 million yen (Art. 92). Provisions take effect in stages by Cabinet Order within nine months to two years of promulgation.

notes: Consolidated text: 2026 amendments (令和八年法律第三十八号) are integrated and their commencement is partly left to cabinet order (政令). The 附則 of this Act cites 附則 Arts. 9-11 (附則 Art. 1(i)), which are absent from the supplied text, and the 附則 contains only Arts. 1-4. Art. 50(1) enumerates 15 designated business types; only seven statutes are listed as relations here, the rest are not recorded. Art. 64 is deleted (削除). Relations stated only in other instruments' 附則 (令和四年法律第四十六号, 令和四年法律第六一号) are not recorded here.
